task: Records fed to parse_record may now optionally carry a phone number. When a record includes a phone, it counts as valid only if the phone is a string of exactly 10 digits; a record that is otherwise valid but has a malformed phone is invalid, same as any other bad field. Records that don't include a phone at all are validated exactly as before. When a record is valid and does include a properly formatted phone, carry it through into the parsed output alongside the existing fields. Keep parse_record's signature and every existing behavior unchanged.
